title: Himalayan and Eastern India private universities recorded ICAR-accredited agriculture programmes for 2026
description: Explore 2026 admission and ICAR accreditation records for Eternal University (HP), Shri Guru Ram Rai University (Uttarakhand), The Neotia University (WB) and Arunachal University of Studies.
summary: Four regional universities across Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, West Bengal and Arunachal Pradesh provide ICAR-listed agriculture programmes tailored to hill, sub-Himalayan and coastal agro-climatic zones.

sections.heading: Four regional institutions across Northern Hills and Eastern India
paragraphs: Students seeking ICAR-listed private agricultural education in the Himalayan states, West Bengal or the North-East can examine four profiled universities: [Eternal University](/university/eternal-university) at Baru Sahib in Himachal Pradesh (a residential women’s university at undergraduate level), [Shri Guru Ram Rai University](/university/shri-guru-ram-rai-university) in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, [The Neotia University](/university/the-neotia-university) at Sarisha (Diamond Harbour Road) in West Bengal, and [Arunachal University of Studies](/university/arunachal-university-of-studies) in Namsai, Arunachal Pradesh.
Each campus operates within a distinct agro-ecological zone, shaping crop practicals, polyhouse cultivation, soil management and local village attachments.

sections.heading: Checking gender rules, residential norms and domicile fee tiers
paragraphs: Before applying, note institution-specific policies—for example, Eternal University’s Akal College of Agriculture admits women candidates for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture in a fully residential hill setting, while Arunachal University of Studies and The Neotia University serve eastern and north-eastern cohorts with specific entrance or CUET/merit criteria. Read [compare two agriculture campuses](/blogs/compare-agriculture-campuses) and [questions to ask before choosing an agriculture college](/blogs/questions-before-choosing-agriculture-college).

faqs.question: Is Eternal University’s B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme open to all applicants?
faqs.answer: Eternal University at Baru Sahib operates as a women’s residential institution for undergraduate programmes; confirm programme-specific eligibility before applying.

faqs.question: How should out-of-state students plan for hill or eastern campuses?
faqs.answer: Check nearest rail/air connectivity, winter or monsoon academic calendars, compulsory hostel rules and total annual living expenses.
